dashboard.lead1: Factory Manager is a local planner for your Satisfactory factories: item catalog, production chains, and power plans. Everything stays on your PC — no account, no cloud.
dashboard.lead2: Set output targets, work out machine counts (including overclock and power shards), set up miners on nodes, and size generators with the right fuel. Resource and power balances update as you go, and the app flags when you are short on materials or power.
dashboard.lead3: This dashboard is a quick overview: recent projects, alerts, production targets, and your generator mix — so you can see what needs attention before you open Production or Power.
dashboard.emptyNoPowerBalance: No power output or use configured yet.
dashboard.featureResourcesBody: In-game item catalog by type: ores, ingots, fluids, and components.
dashboard.featureProductionBody: Save and reopen factory projects without relying on the cloud.
dashboard.featureEnergyBody: Design extraction and generators to feed your factory.
dashboard.emptyProjectsHint: Create a production chain or power plan to get started.
dashboard.emptyAllOk: All clear — no deficits detected in your projects.

legal.sectionAbout.p1: Factory Manager is independent, unofficial fan-made software — a planning tool for Satisfactory players, not an official Coffee Stain product.
legal.sectionAbout.p2: It helps you work out production chains: resources, recipes, cycle times, inputs and outputs, machine counts, power, and how to organize a factory layout.

legal.sectionIndependence.p3: It is a community project made by enthusiasts, for information and planning support.
